findings.source_quote: “Because they lived their love they had their heads cut off and were drowned.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the active wording with passive wording, for example: “משום שחיו את אהבתם, נערפו ראשיהם והם הוטבעו.”
findings.translation_quote: “משום שחיו את אהבתם, ערפו את ראשיהם והטביעו אותם.”
